sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:187

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:187:1
items.html: The eight white ways are drawn from the head through the sides of the face, and they are two Names of HaVaYaH shining in these two corners: As stated in the adjacent item, that at the time of the coupling, when Arich Anpin and Radla [the unknown head] become one head, the hairs of the beard rise and join with the hairs of the head into one level, and then they receive from the returning surrounding light. And it is now found that the whiteness and the hairs of the head become literally one and the same discernment; and it is discerned that the whiteness bestows upon the fine hairs, and they become Yods, and the Vavs descend to the thirteen corrections of the beard, as above. And what is stated, that the corners remain in the discernment of Metzpatz — the intention is after this coupling, for then they return to their fixed discernment, which is the discernment of Vavs, and the corners return to the discernment of Metzpatz. As stated in other places.
